body: Providers watermark the outputs of large language models, while applications sample many responses per prompt for self-consistency, best-of-n selection, and uncertainty estimation. We show that deployed configurations of distortion-free watermarks, which deduplicate keyed contexts only within a response, couple the responses of a request: answer templates make all responses query the watermark with the same context before the answer, so collisions across responses, usually assumed rare, become the norm. Key pools reduce or avoid the coupling at the cost of multiple testing, and the exact remedy of a context history shared across the request leaves many positions unwatermarked. We propose SOLO, which keeps a request-scoped context history but anchors its keyed contexts on content selected by min-hash, so that siblings rarely compete for a context and random edits stay local. Its responses are jointly distributed as independent unwatermarked responses, each detectable with a single key. On five language models from three families and three benchmarks, SOLO preserves self-consistency and uncertainty estimation and, at a 1% false positive rate, detects more responses than four-token key pools on most tasks, also after randomly editing 10% of the tokens, and more than the context history on most clean tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/ZhongliangGuo/solo-watermark.
summaryZh: SOLO：通过内容锚定的单所有者上下文在重复采样下实现样本忠实且可检测的 LLM 水印。提供者对大型语言模型的输出进行水印，而应用程序根据提示对许多响应进行采样，以实现自我一致性、最佳选择和不确定性估计。我们展示了无失真水印的部署配置，它仅在响应中删除重复的键控上下文，耦合请求的响应：答案模板使所有响应在答案之前使用相同的上下文查询水印，因此通常假设很少见的响应之间的冲突成为常态。
